# Residential Lease Agreement

This Lease Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between the Landlord and the Tenant
identified on the signature page. The parties agree to the following terms.

## 1. Premises

1.1 The Landlord leases to the Tenant the residential unit located at 123 Example Way,
Springfield, including all fixtures and appliances installed at the time of move-in.

1.2 The Tenant accepts the premises in their current condition and acknowledges receipt
of the move-in inspection checklist.

## 2. Term

2.1 The lease term shall commence on the first day of the calendar month following
execution of this Agreement and continue for a period of twelve (12) months.

2.2 At the conclusion of the initial term, this Agreement shall automatically convert
to a month-to-month tenancy unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at
least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the initial term.

## 3. Rent

3.1 The Tenant shall pay monthly rent in the amount of $1,800.00, due on the first day
of each calendar month.

3.2 Rent payments received after the fifth day of the month shall incur a late fee of
$50.00. Repeated late payments may constitute grounds for termination.

## 4. Security Deposit

4.1 The Tenant shall deposit with the Landlord a security deposit equal to one month's
rent prior to occupancy.

4.2 The security deposit shall be returned to the Tenant within thirty (30) days of
move-out, less any deductions for damages beyond ordinary wear and tear.

## 5. Termination

5.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach upon thirty (30) days'
written notice and an opportunity to cure.

5.2 Upon termination, the Tenant shall vacate the premises and return all keys, leaving
the unit in the same condition as at move-in, ordinary wear and tear excepted.
